config_path.description: Absolute path of the configuration file the daemon loaded.

daemon.description: Build information of the daemon binary.

loom_home.description: Absolute path of the loom home directory the daemon uses.

socket_path.description: Absolute path of the unix socket the daemon listens on.

ApiVersion.description:
Version of the loomd API a message belongs to.

A breaking change to any API type adds a variant; compatible changes (new optional fields,
new endpoints) keep the current one.

Channel.description: Release channel, set with `LOOM_CHANNEL` at build time.

oneOf.description: Prerelease built from every merge to `main`.
Any other build, such as `cargo build` on a workstation. Default when `LOOM_CHANNEL` is unset.

Profile.description: Cargo profile family, as reported by Cargo's `PROFILE` build variable.

oneOf.description: `dev` or `test` profile, or a custom profile inheriting from them.
`release` or `bench` profile, or a custom profile inheriting from them.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with whole seconds, such as 2026-10-12T08:00:00Z.

VersionInfo.description: Build information embedded in a loom binary at compile time.

channel.description: Release channel the binary was built for.

commit.description: Full git commit hash of the build, or `unknown` outside a git checkout.

commit_date.description: Committer date of `commit` in strict ISO 8601, or `unknown` outside a git checkout.

profile.description: Cargo profile the binary was built with.

target.description: Target triple the binary was compiled for.

version.description: Release version: `LOOM_BUILD_VERSION` at build time, otherwise the crate version.
